# Evals

**Status: method only. No labels, harness or results exist yet.** `evals/results/RESULTS.md` will be generated by the harness and never edited by hand. `evals/ERROR_ANALYSIS.md` is written by a person after reading the failures.

## Dataset

- 50 or more real photos of ingredient labels in `evals/labels/`, including hard cases (curved packs, glare, small print, Hindi or other scripts, dark backgrounds). Use `LABEL_CHECKLIST.md`.
- One ground-truth file per photo: `evals/labels/<id>.json` (schema below), transcribed from the photo and **reviewed by the repo owner**. `RESULTS.md` will state who produced and who reviewed the ground truth. Open Food Facts images, if used, are attributed and marked as such, and their ground truth is also reviewed, not copied.
- Splits are fixed by a file (`evals/split.json`) before any tuning, so results are not tuned to the test set.

```json
{
  "id": "lbl_001",
  "source": "photographed | open_food_facts",
  "ingredients_text": "exact text on the label",
  "ingredients": ["canonical names in label order"],
  "additives": ["E330"],
  "allergens_declared": ["milk", "soy"],
  "notes": "glare on the right third"
}
```

## Metrics (defined before measuring)

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| OCR accuracy | Character error rate and word error rate of extracted ingredient text vs. `ingredients_text`, for ML Kit and for Gemini vision, per label. |
| Ingredient-mapping accuracy | Share of ground-truth ingredients and additives correctly mapped to the canonical name / E-number. This is the re-measurement of the resume's "98% data-mapping accuracy"; it reports whatever it finds. |
| Allergen detection precision and recall | Over (label, synthetic profile) pairs. Profiles are generated from a fixed list of allergens. Truth = allergen present in ground truth. **False negatives (a missed allergen) are listed individually** because they are the dangerous error. |
| Medicine / condition rule check | Same, for the offline medicine-list and condition rules, on a small hand-built set of cases whose expected output is written down before the run. |
| Citation correctness | For each cited warning, a human checks that the cited chunk supports the claim. Reported as supported / not supported / no source found. Sample size stated. |
| Latency | p50 and p95 per path (on-device only, cloud warm, cloud cold), number of runs stated, device and network stated. |
| Cost per scan | Token counts times current published prices, with the price table and date recorded in `RESULTS.md`. |

## Rules

- No number goes into the README, resume or PR unless it comes from `RESULTS.md`.
- Every run records: git commit, date, model names and versions, region, number of labels.
- If a result is worse than the resume, the resume changes (see `RESUME_FACTS.md`).
